faq.q1: How do I reset my password?
faq.a1: Go to Settings → Change Password. Enter your current password and choose a new one. If you have forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" link on the login screen.
faq.q2: How do I delete my account?
faq.a2: Go to Settings and tap "Delete Account" at the bottom. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
faq.q3: Why can't I see someone's posts?
faq.a3: The account may be private. Send them a follow request to access their content.
faq.q4: How do I report a post or user?
faq.a4: Email us at support@framee.app with a link to the post or profile and a brief description. We review all reports and take appropriate action within 24 hours.
faq.a5: Email us at support@framee.app. We respond to all inquiries within 2 business days.
